A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Pointer-CAD work and contain readable main text, references, and supplementary Sections 9–13. Their equations, tables, figures, and appendix content support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original text-to-CAD experiments, quantitative comparisons, GNN ablations, quantization analyses, and generated examples in the main text and appendix.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including the benchmark comparisons and supplementary analyses. Retained results qualify even without evidence of new experimental runs.

M1.justification: Section 4.1.1 revises the specified edge update: v1 uses residual multi-head attention, while v2 adds an MLP term combining the edge state with projected embeddings of its incident faces. This is a localized architectural revision; the pointer representation, decoder, and losses remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether models were retrained.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Recap-DeepCAD, Recap-OmniCAD/+, and Text2CAD coverage. Normalized-prompt evaluations, single-versus-multiple extrusion scenarios, and interactive editing already appear in v1 and are retained.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same methods: DeepCAD, Text2CAD, CADmium, Text-to-CadQuery, cadrille, and the general-purpose LLMs. Text-to-CadQuery's appendix comparison is present in both versions, despite surrounding text moving.

E3.justification: Reported experimental settings are unchanged, including ten training epochs, normalized evaluation coordinates, 8,192 sampled points for Chamfer Distance, the 2K subsets for LLM comparisons, and supplementary evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: Both retain the GNN ablation, error-accumulation comparison, normalization and truncation analyses, quantization sweep, and complex/failure examples. Table 7 is relocated, not newly added; its single-versus-multiple extrusion analysis is unchanged.

E5.justification: Section 9.2 already reports averaging COV, MMD, and JSD over three independent runs in v1, and v2 retains this practice. No seed information, uncertainty estimates, or statistical tests are added or changed.

E6.justification: Matched result tables and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Table 3(a) retains Pointer-CAD-0.5B's reported mean CD of 3.81 and SegE of 0.13, while Table 10 retains Pointer-CAD-1.5B's IR of 6.59. The appendix adds no result entries.

T1.justification: The formal edge-embedding recurrence in Section 4.1.1 gains a non-equivalent term involving a new MLP ψ, learnable scalar γ, and projection fΞ. Other mathematical definitions and loss expressions remain unchanged; no theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about pointer-based entity selection, chamfer/fillet support, reduced quantization-related errors, and improved geometric and topological fidelity.

C2.justification: Section 4.1.1 replaces the shared-vertex rationale for edge attention with an explanation combining incident-node information and global dependencies. Performance interpretations and limitations concerning text conditioning, single-part modeling, and non-manifold topology remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures and the code-availability statement are retained. Section 13 still specifies approximately 23 hours on 16 H800 GPUs, AdamW with learning rate 10^-4, and the same batching and sequence-length settings; its movement onto page 18 adds no information.

R1.justification: Both versions cite the same 65 works and retain their research positioning. Changes such as CadQuery/FreeCAD renumbering and OpenCoder's publication metadata update concern bibliography presentation rather than new literature or revised novelty claims.

P1.justification: v2 makes limited prose edits, clarifies the Table 6 discussion, corrects a typo, and revises affiliations and contribution/correspondence notes. Bibliographic entries are polished, while the section organization and overall narrative remain stable.

P2.justification: Table 7 moves from page 12 to page 13, Figure 11 is reduced in size, Figure 12 changes columns, and Figures 13–14 are respaced. The Table 6 caption is clarified. These are localized presentation changes without new visual evidence.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves technical exposition through the explicit incident-face aggregation term and its matching local/global explanation in Section 4.1.1, alongside limited prose and bibliography cleanup. The experiments and limitations remain unchanged, so this supports a small communication improvement without establishing a performance benefit from the revised update.
